tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that deliver to, or offer pickup near, a US location. Returns restaurant_id, cuisines, distance when a street address is given, Yelp rating when one is on file, and the restaurant page URL. Ask for a ZIP code, city and state, or street address before calling if you do

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Get a restaurant's BringMeThat menu: sections, items with item_id, descriptions, prices, and option groups (including which ones are required). Prices are item prices; checkout adds the fees create_checkout_link describes. Use restaurant_id from search_restaurants. Large menus can be narrowed with s

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Build a bringmethat.com checkout link for the customer's items. Opening checkout_url fills their cart and opens bringmethat.com checkout, where they review the total and pay. Does not charge a card and does not place the order. Validates items and required options first and returns prices, or the pr

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the status of a BringMeThat order. Does not change the order. Needs the order number (starts with R) and the email used at checkout; details are returned only when both match.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_restaurants" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that deliver to, or offer pickup near, a US location. Returns restaurant_id, cuisines, distance when a street address is given, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_restaurants, get_order_status · Private data: search_restaurants · Public sink: get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_restaurants, get_order_status · Private data: search_restaurants · Public sink: get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
